import pyarrow.parquet as pq
import re

def convert(src, dst):
    t = pq.read_table(src).to_pydict()
    labels = t['label']
    texts = t['text']
    n = 0
    with open(dst, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        for lab, txt in zip(labels, texts):
            if txt is None:
                txt = ''
            txt = txt.replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ').replace('\t', ' ')
            f.write(f"__label__{int(lab)} {txt}\n")
            n += 1
    print(dst, n, 'rows')

convert('/app/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet', '/app/work/train.txt')
convert('/app/data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet', '/app/work/test.txt')
EOF

import fasttext, os, time, sys
def run(tag, **kw):
    t0=time.time()
    args = dict(input='train.txt', thread=64, verbose=0, seed=42)
    args.update(kw)
    m = fasttext.train_supervised(**args)
    n,p,r = m.test('test.txt')
    fn = f'{tag}.bin'
    m.save_model(fn)
    sz = os.path.getsize(fn)/1e6
    print(f'{tag}: acc={p:.4f} size={sz:.1f}MB time={time.time()-t0:.0f}s', flush=True)
    return p, sz
